findings.description: The bucket has no ACL specified but is commented as public with no bucket_public_access_block or private ACL set, allowing unauthorized read/write access to sensitive data.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined, so objects stored in this bucket are not encrypted at rest.
No versioning block is configured, increasing risk of accidental or malicious data loss/overwrite without recovery capability.
A sensitive file (customer-master.xlsx) is uploaded to the aws_s3_bucket.data bucket which is public and unencrypted, exposing confidential customer data.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined, so financial data stored in this bucket is not encrypted at rest.
No versioning block is configured for a bucket holding financial data, risking data loss or tampering without recovery.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined, so objects in this operations bucket are not encrypted at rest.
No server_side_encryption_configuration block is defined, leaving data science bucket contents unencrypted at rest.
